manifest_row.title: Volcanoes helped topple ancient Egypt, finds new research

screening.main_topic: How volcanic eruptions and climate-related changes to Nile flooding may have contributed to social stress and political instability in ancient Egypt, with implications for modern societies.
screening.climate_relevance: The article discusses volcanic effects on the climate system, drought, agricultural impacts, and explicitly connects the research to the current climate change debate and modern climate risks.
screening.reason: Climate impacts are central to the account of the study: volcanic eruptions altered Nile flooding and contributed to drought and social stress. The article also draws out the relevance of volcanic climate disturbances for present-day societies.
